# ribosome

> text generator with llm magic

## Modules

- [ribosome.preprocessing.ocr.audit_repair](https://binjian.github.io/ribosome/03.preprocessing.ocr.audit_repair.html.md): Validate structured OCR layout sidecars without making OCR or network calls, and retain actionable region-level findings for a later repair pass.
- [ribosome.preprocessing.ocr.baidu_unlimited](https://binjian.github.io/ribosome/03.preprocessing.ocr.baidu_unlimited.html.md): Recursively parse PDF pages, Office documents, and images into Markdown with a remote [Baidu Unlimited-OCR](https://github.com/baidu/Unlimited-OCR) vLLM service.
